name: hud_sensor_tracker_update
description: HudSensorTracker::Update advances map scale state, establishes tracker fallback vectors as needed, draws map nodes in offline mode, updates save-state markers, and draws the tracked save-state marker when the map is loaded.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x417130 has no warnings or tags and shows mapScaleLerpStep assignment, early return when both lerp flags are clear, UpdateMapScaleLerp, optional fallback origin/forward setup, offline map-node iteration, save-state list iteration, and tracked save-state marker draw when mapLoadedFlag is set.
Direct authored callees UpdateMapScaleLerp, zOpt::GetNetworkEnabled, DrawOnTracker, DrawSaveStateMarker, and DrawTrackedSaveStateMarker are dependency-ready and functional-equivalent.
The native HUD update smoke verifies the early-return case and the offline map-node iteration path, including immediate-line output from a map node and mapScaleLerpStep assignment.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x417130 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
